title: Transferable Design Themes
description: Portable visual-system briefs for applying six distinct design directions across websites and digital products.

usage.principle: Treat each theme as a system of visual and interaction rules, not a color preset.
adaptation: Map the palette to the host site's brand and accessibility requirements while preserving the theme's signature contrast.
Apply the layout, typography, component, imagery, and motion guidance consistently across key pages.
Keep navigation, forms, and primary actions easy to find even when the visual treatment is experimental.
Use semantic HTML, keyboard-visible focus, reduced-motion support, and readable contrast.

tokens.colorValues: Hex values are starting points; tune them for contrast and brand fit.
tokens.fontFamilies: Font names are descriptive directions. Select licensed, available web fonts with similar characteristics.
tokens.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and avoid flashing effects.

themes.name: Dada Riot
themes.concept: Punk zine meets anti-establishment art school: handmade, confrontational, and deliberately disruptive.

typography.display: Heavy condensed grotesk or distressed display sans
typography.accent: Typewriter or handwritten annotation style, used sparingly
typography.treatment: Mix scale and alignment like cut-and-paste print media while keeping text hierarchy clear.

layout.density: High-energy focal areas balanced by clear reading paths and calmer content zones.

themes.imagery: Photocopy textures, scanned paper, cutout photography, halftones, ink marks, and imperfect print registration.
themes.motion: Brief irregular shifts, paper flicks, rough reveals, and sharp cuts; keep movement purposeful and restrained.
guardrails: Do not make every element chaotic.
Keep essential controls conventional and easy to locate.

themes.name: Neo-Brutalist Jester
themes.concept: A hard-edged digital printshop: bold, direct, playful, and slightly unruly.

typography.display: Oversized heavy grotesk or condensed sans
typography.accent: Compact uppercase labels and blunt microcopy
typography.treatment: Use scale, weight, and tight line breaks for impact; keep body text calm.

layout.density: Bold focal elements with enough whitespace to make each block legible.

themes.imagery: Graphic poster art, flat illustrations, strong cutouts, high-contrast photography, and simple geometric shapes.
themes.motion: Snappy slides, hard cuts, cursor-led accents, and small positional shifts that support the print-poster character.
guardrails: Do not turn every panel into a headline.
Reserve the strongest color for key actions and emphasis.
Keep small text readable against saturated backgrounds.

themes.name: Neon Trickster
themes.concept: Digital nightlife and cyberpunk interface, with a clever guide moving through an electric, high-energy system.

typography.display: Geometric display sans with futuristic proportions
typography.body: Neutral sans-serif optimized for dark interfaces
typography.accent: Monospace labels for data, states, and technical details
typography.treatment: Use luminous color for short emphasis, never for long passages.

layout.density: Structured dashboard-like zones punctuated by vivid focal panels.

themes.imagery: Night-city scenes, abstract light trails, holographic surfaces, digital textures, and high-contrast character art.
themes.motion: Subtle pulses, controlled flickers, parallax, and card transitions; avoid flashing or destabilizing text.
guardrails: Maintain strong contrast for text and controls.
Keep essential text stable and free of glitch effects.
Use animation selectively and support reduced-motion preferences.

themes.name: Luxury Bento / Velvet Gallery
themes.concept: A private exhibition space: refined, composed, and editorial, with modern modular layouts.

typography.treatment: Use contrast between expressive headlines and restrained supporting text.

layout.density: Moderate density with careful spacing and a small number of strong focal points.

themes.imagery: Art-directed photography, tactile materials, sculptural objects, gallery interiors, and restrained color grading.
themes.motion: Slow fades, gentle image reveals, subtle hover lift, and smooth transitions.
guardrails: Do not let oversized margins hide important content.
Keep buttons and navigation visibly interactive.

themes.name: The Impossible Court
themes.concept: Surrealist theatre inside an impossible palace: strange, elegant, and designed around discovery.

typography.accent: Small theatrical labels or chapter markers
typography.treatment: Pair evocative titles with plain-language navigation and explanatory text.

layout.density: Sparse, cinematic compositions with clearly signposted content destinations.

themes.imagery: Impossible architecture, dreamlike landscapes, theatrical lighting, symbolic objects, and surreal still-life compositions.
themes.motion: Slow spatial transitions, shifting perspective, floating objects, and restrained scroll-linked scene changes.
guardrails: Do not turn navigation into a puzzle.
Always show users where they are and how to continue.
Provide a static, accessible experience when motion is unavailable or reduced.

themes.name: The Forbidden Library
themes.concept: A secret archive of knowledge: scholarly, atmospheric, and slightly dangerous.

typography.body: Highly legible text face for sustained reading
typography.accent: Archival monospace or small-cap catalog labels
typography.treatment: Use a clear typographic hierarchy for titles, annotations, source notes, and body copy.

layout.density: Content-rich but orderly, with a strong distinction between primary text and annotations.

themes.imagery: Manuscripts, engraved illustrations, book textures, archival photography, ink drawings, and warm directional light.
themes.motion: Subtle page-like reveals, ink transitions, gentle light shifts, and restrained movement between archive sections.
guardrails: Avoid faux-aged styling that harms readability.
Keep contrast strong and sources easy to scan.
Do not let decorative textures compete with long-form text.
